issues.detail: Hebrew 'אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְעַדְרִיאֵל' means 'whom she bore to Adriel' (i.e., she gave birth to them for Adriel), but Vietnamese 'mà bà đã nuôi cho A-đơ-ri-ên' says 'whom she raised/nurtured for Adriel' — 'nuôi' (to raise/nurture) changes the meaning from bearing to raising, a substantive difference.
